verdict.rationale: Dagster is a data-orchestration platform, not an AI agent that itself consumes external tools; the evidence shows Dagster exposing an MCP *server* so other AI agents can control Dagster (docs-14, probe-3) and AI skills for coding agents to build Dagster projects (docs-13/34), but nothing about Dagster acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to gain new tool capabilities. This 'plug servers into it' client-side story is a category mismatch for an orchestration engine rather than an agentic assistant.
